verdict.rationale: Supabase supports least-privilege agent access via Postgres Row Level Security (RLS) and, for custom MCP servers, wiring Auth so that 'every tool call runs as that user under RLS policies' (docs-45, docs-7). Community evidence also shows the official MCP server added a read-only mode as a mitigation after a security researcher demonstrated that the default service_role connection bypassed RLS and leaked data via a prompt-injection attack (comm-1, comm-2), showing scoping exists but was not secure-by-default and remains an active risk area. Missing for 10: first-party docs on issuing per-agent scoped API keys/tokens (e.g., personal access token scoping, project-level MCP permission granularity) and independent confirmation that the read-only/RLS mitigations fully prevent privilege escalation.
